notes: All sheets use true transparent alpha.
Every frame uses the same 384x512 cell.
Lumiere visually floats slightly above the baseline and does not make direct ground contact.
Movement animation uses hovering instead of walking.
Hover motion is expressed through subtle vertical bobbing, wing movement, hair sway, and flowing drapery.
Heterochromia must remain consistent in every visible-eye frame.
Front view: viewer-left eye is violet and viewer-right eye is azure.
Left-facing profile: visible eye is azure.
Right-facing profile: visible eye is violet.
